selection_reason: The current b/c mass-scheme map rows target native-scale-to-MZ external running-mass rows below the electroweak threshold layer. The matching tau external row is therefore the Huang-Zhou MZ EFT charged-lepton row, not the full-SM MZ row. This selects an external map convention only; it does not select Rtheta or close the full-SM threshold conversion.
